article.title: Arkansas hosts No. 20 South Carolina in SEC matchup
article.linkText: Arkansas hosts No. 20 South Carolina in SEC matchup
article.story: No. 20 South Carolina (6-3) at Arkansas (3-6), Nov. 14 at 7:45 p.m. EST. Opening Line: South Carolina by 7.5. Against the spread: South Carolina 5-4, Arkansas 4-5. How to watch: SEC Network Key stats South Carolina Offense Overall: 452.6 yards per game (21st in FBS) Passing: 247.1 yards per game (41st) Rushing: 205.4 yards per game (20th) Scoring: 34.7 points per game (24th) South Carolina Defense Overall: 353.4 yards per game (63rd in FBS) Passing: 228.2 yards per game (94th) Rushing: 125.2 yards per game (42nd) Scoring: 23.4 points per game (58th) Arkansas Offense Overall: 337.9 yards per game (116th in FBS) Passing: 225.4 yards per game (76th) Rushing: 112.4 yards per game (122nd) Scoring: 20 points per game (121st) Arkansas Defense Overall: 361.9 yards per game (74th in FBS) Passing: 205.6 yards per game (55th) Rushing: 156.3 yards per game (86th) Scoring: 27.4 points per game (95th) Arkansas ranks 99th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 41.1% of the time. South Carolina ranks 23rd on offense, converting on 46.4% of third downs. South Carolina ranks 127th in the FBS with a -7 turnover margin. Arkansas is 105th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 88.6% of trips. South Carolina's red zone offense ranks 25th, scoring on 90.9% of red zone opportunities. South Carolina is 89th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:29, compared to Arkansas' 32nd-ranked average of 31:36. Team leaders South Carolina Passing: LaNorris Sellers, 2,100 yards, 17 TDs, 7 INTs, 62.8 completion percentage Rushing: Sellers, 637 yards on 104 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Mazeo Bennett Jr., 497 yards on 38 catches, 5 TDs Arkansas Passing: K.J. Jackson, 1,853 yards, 8 TDs, 6 INTs, 59.1 completion percentage Rushing: Cam Settles, 314 yards on 71 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Chris Marshall, 698 yards on 48 catches, 2 TDs Last game South Carolina won 17-9 over Texas A&M on Nov. 7. Sellers passed for 251 yards on 20-of-31 attempts (64.5%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball six times for 34 yards and one rushing touchdown. Isaiah Augustave had 50 rushing yards on 10 carries, adding two receptions for four yards. Nyck Harbor had four receptions for 70 yards. Arkansas fell 26-23 to Auburn on Nov. 7. Jackson led Arkansas with 180 yards on 14-of-30 passing (46.7%) for one touchdown and one interception. Settles had 100 rushing yards on 16 carries. Marshall recorded 65 yards on five catches. Next game South Carolina hosts No. 1 Georgia on Nov. 21. Arkansas plays at No. 8 Texas on Nov. 21.
